impedanceProfiles.name: USB4 and PCIe surface pairs
impedanceProfiles.status: manufacturer calculator geometry applied to saved surface routes; full SI validation pending
impedanceProfiles.model: Differential Pair (Non coplanar), with solder mask
impedanceProfiles.note: The calculator search tolerance is not the fabrication tolerance. Nearby top copper requires a coplanar model or sufficient separation. BGA necks and pad launches require separate review.

calculatorGuideTraceModel.note: The calculator guide uses 1.6 mil outer trace copper and a 0.7 mil top-to-base width reduction. The stackup illustration lists nominal outer foil as 0.035 mm. Preserve this distinction in independent EM analysis.

impedanceProfiles.model: Differential Pair (Non coplanar), with solder mask
impedanceProfiles.note: The outer copper, 0.0994 mm dielectric and solder-mask model are nominally symmetric. The top calculator geometry is reused for L6 referenced to L5. Nearby bottom copper, via launches and pad transitions need separate SI review. This is not an independent field-solver result.

calculatorGuideTraceModel.note: The calculator guide uses 1.6 mil outer trace copper and a 0.7 mil top-to-base width reduction. The stackup illustration lists nominal outer foil as 0.035 mm. Preserve this distinction in independent EM analysis.

laminate.note: The JLCPCB calculator guide specifies NP-155F for 4-8 layers and requires the corresponding material at ordering. Specify this family and obtain the exact core/prepreg variant. The stackup code alone does not guarantee a production assignment. The linked supplier sheets do not specify Df at 10 GHz.

implementation.note: The circuit declares six copper layers and nominal board thickness. This file records the fabrication recipe. It does not configure dielectric thicknesses in the router or establish field-solver validation.
